blocks.text: PURA D'OR Advanced Therapy Shampoo and Conditioner Set for thinning hair helps strengthen hair, and minimize breakage. It is one of PURA D'OR's best selling shampoo and conditioner sets because of its extra strength feature that increases volume and thickness of your hair, keeping it moisturized and tangle-free all day long. Our advanced shampoo and conditioner contains 17 key active ingredients in the shampoo and plant-based preservative system, each with twice the concentration to support and ensure a moisturized and healthier hair from roots to tips without any signs of distress, breakage, or leaving it flat. Our Proprietary Herbal Blend with ingredients such as Saw Palmetto, Nettle extracts, Biotin, He Shou Wu, Red Korean Seaweed, Pygeum Bark Extract, and other exotic herbs to combat signs of hair thinning are part of the proprietary blend. Even with the double concentration formula, our sulfate-free shampoo and conditioner is still safe for our daily routine use on any hair types including natural hair, colored treated or dry and damaged hair, for both men and women. It is free from harsh chemicals and paraben-free. It is hypoallergenic, vegan, environmentally responsible, and cruelty-free.
